wiki.title: Jeff Eldridge
wiki.extract: Jeffrey Allen Eldridge (born January 13, 1967) is an American politician and a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates representing District 30 since 2024. He represented District 22 from January 12, 2013 to 2018 as a Democrat. Eldridge served non-consecutively from January 2005 until January 2011 in the District 19 seat.
